title: 12 Days - From Nothing To 500 Users For A Protoype
author: bingewavecinema
selftext:
12 Days, I had an idea of making a city builder based on the movie and book "World Of The Worlds" because...why not? And now the game has its initial users! Even though its rough.

This will be on of the topics at the AI Game Festival: [How To Prototype An Iterate Quickly With AI, then Find Publishers + Investors.](https://www.glitch.fun/gameshows/9eadde86-a1b2-4882-86e4-a3e9e2e08814/schedule/01a04a3f-bcfc-7127-8523-8b7e9bf53b74/standalone)

* 2 days get the core loop of the game down for the city builder
* 5 days to complete the all of the assets. There are 180 assets in this game! (building, troops aliens, terrain, etc). City builder are large games.
* 5 days to work on performance, which was a real time sinker because of the WebGPU limitations

And then I start to promote. Now early promotion is NOT about the masses, its about catering to die-hard fans that want to see you succeed at the earliest stages.

So now for the next 2 weeks on get feedback, polish and continue to refine until I decide if that the game is ready for full release.

comments.author: speps
comments.body: It’s “War of the Worlds”, not “World of the Worlds”. And can explain the WebGPU limitations that you had? Game looks like WebGL could handle it 🤔

replies.author: bingewavecinema
replies.body:
Ha, thank for you that.

Actually first thing is its use WebGPU as the primary and WebGL has a fallback.

The assets and animation I have my blender files are actually higher quality, but when you get to webgpu/webgpu, you limited on triangles, drawcalls and other functionality. For example, at around 300 drawcalls my FPS drops to about 20, 600 drawcasles FPS is at 10.

If this was a Vulkan or DirectX game, 500 draw calls would be nothing.

Btw, there is a whole talk about all these being given: [How To Optimize Your Game With AI](https://www.glitch.fun/gameshows/9eadde86-a1b2-4882-86e4-a3e9e2e08814/schedule/01a0353d-a068-7154-9558-82d719cd7df4/standalone)
